revision_basis: Reconstruction pin verified against the measured CSV's Git blob identity, all document texts and the complete retrieval index; the original run did not record a dataset revision.
corpus_hash_format: SHA256 of UTF-8 lines '<basename>\0<text SHA256>\n', sorted by basename; \0 is a NUL byte.
document_rendering: Parsed JSON rendered with html_table_parser.py, preserving numeric cell text.
retrieval_rendering: Creators' published treasury_bulletins_parsed/transformed text, which uses a different table renderer from the document archive.
